scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && node -e "require('fs').accessSync('client/dist/index.html'); console.log('client/dist ready')"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
